steps.title: Define App Metadata and Schema
steps.description: Configure app-meta.json, api_schema.json, and AndroidManifest.xml with application credentials and permissions.

steps.title: Configure Gradle Build Files
steps.description: Setup project and module level build.gradle files with target SDK 34 and Java 8 compatibility.

steps.title: Configure App Meta Asset
steps.description: Create app-meta.json inside assets directory for runtime app_id resolution.

steps.title: Create User Interface Dimensions and Strings
steps.description: Define strings, colors, and layout resources for auth and gallery views.

steps.title: Implement Backend Authentication Client
steps.description: Develop BackendApi.java for authentication flows including register, login, logout, and token caching.

steps.title: Implement Image Worker Client
steps.description: Develop ImageWorkerApi.java for multipart upload, image listing, and authenticated byte fetching.

steps.title: Implement Image Compression Utility
steps.description: Create ImageCompressor.java to resize and compress photos down to under 200 KB before upload.

steps.title: Build Authentication Activity UI and Logic
steps.description: Implement LoginActivity and its layout with register/login toggle and forgot-password OTP support.

steps.title: Build Gallery Grid Layout and Custom Adapter
steps.description: Construct grid layouts and gallery view adapter for asynchronous image fetching and display.

steps.title: Implement Main Gallery Activity
steps.description: Create MainActivity for image selection via system picker, background compression, upload, and gallery viewing.

steps.title: Implement Fullscreen Image Preview
steps.description: Create PreviewActivity and layout to inspect loaded high-resolution private images.

steps.title: Building ImageVault
steps.description: Assemble and build the application package via gradle.
